creditsHtml:
Historical results and prices

Valuebetennis — Tennis results and odds since 2021, used under CC BY 4.0. We filtered and reconciled the records, matched player identities, combined eligible Pinnacle snapshots, and calculated the displayed hypothetical flat-stake returns. These calculations are Il Margine’s presentation of the historical data, not an endorsement by the source.

Supplemental Pinnacle archive prices: Tennis-Data and timestamp-checked Il Margine captures. Match results reconciled with OnCourt. Supplemental snapshots are not assumed to be closing prices.
